text:
Kai (People Ops): quick heads-up — midcycle evidence transfer window opens next week. a couple clarifying Qs from managers before we publish the final steps.
Devon (Eng Manager): do we need to re-upload evidence if someone moved teams since they submitted?
Riley (People Ops Partner): short answer: yes only if the manager of record changed. we pull evidence by manager assignment on cutoff.
Devon (Eng Manager): ok — what's the official cutoff date? managers are prepping reviews.
Kai (People Ops): cutoff is 2025-05-15 23:59 PT. anything after that goes to the next cycle unless you submit an "exception request" (see process below).
Ava (People Ops): note on transfers: use the evidence-transfer form to move files and ownership, it retains timestamps. link: https://intranet.redwood.com/promo-evidence-transfer
Devon (Eng Manager): thanks — if i submit transfer + evidence before cutoff, does calibration see it in the same bucket?
Riley (People Ops Partner): yes, transferred evidence that completes before cutoff is included in your team's calibration packet. we run a verification job 1hr after cutoff to catch late sync issues.
Sam (Payroll): heads up — payroll needs final comp change authorizations by 2025-05-20 to hit the June payroll. exceptions push to next cycle payroll.
Devon (Eng Manager): what about backfill/slotting? if someone is promoted and we want to open their IC slot earlier, any special approvals?
Kai (People Ops): backfill requests follow the normal hiring ops flow but you can tag as "promo-backfill" for priority review. approvals are same-day for headcount already approved, otherwise 48-72 hrs.
Ava (People Ops): manager overrides / upward adjustments: if you want to request a leveling override after calibration, file an "override justification" doc and ping @Riley. these are limited and require evidence of scope / impact.
Devon (Eng Manager): can we see a short checklist for managers? makes it easier to run through teams.
Riley (People Ops Partner): yes — checklist: 1) confirm manager of record in Workday, 2) upload evidence or transfer, 3) complete calibration rating sheet, 4) submit comp-change form if promo approved, 5) file override if needed. i'll paste a template in #people-ops-resources.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Midcycle evidence transfer window open" on 2025-05-08 09:00 PT.
Devon (Eng Manager): perfect. one last: if someone disputes their rating post-calibration, what's the appeal path?
Ava (People Ops): we have a 14-day appeal window from the day managers are notified. appeals go to panel review (manager, peer manager, people ops partner). submit via the appeal form on the intranet.
Devon (Eng Manager): all good — i'll share with my managers. thanks team :thumbsup:
Kai (People Ops): thanks — i'll update the playbook and drop links in #people-ops-resources and the templates repo.
